scope: Two basic action foundation templates only. The aggregate SFMClientActions registry and UI or machine action implementations are excluded.

production_input_policy.historical_sources: Frozen Git blobs are migration witnesses only. No production source selection reads them.
production_input_policy.normalization: none; all six raw witnesses use LF and a final LF
production_input_policy.file_membership: Both paths are absent in every release witness. Root-owned source rules must omit both before reading/rendering when client_actions is disabled.

client_actions.scope: Basic registered action parsing, list/help/invoke dispatch and availability checks. This flag does not grant permissions or include aggregate registry registrations.

command_palette.scope: Legacy fuzzy action-ID suggestions. UI theme, keyboard and screen requirements belong to UI consumers, not this command-tree foundation.

typed_command_palette.scope: Advanced typed frontier, candidates, stable component search text, literal continuations and opt-in action completion. The D2 history/context additions are independently gated.

command_history.scope: History service injection, historical arguments, ranking boosts and history-only constructor parameters.

context_actions.scope: Isolated palette choice surfaces, display texts and choice ranking. No workspace action implementations are included by these two files.

client_action_completion_diagnostics.scope: Slow-provider timing and logging, plus the compiler's completion-provider comment. Independent of typed palette/history/context behavior.

client_action_nullable_suggestions.scope: Preserve the D2 final suggestion-projection null-ID guard. This is not a claim that every nullable Brigadier node path has been fixed.

member_owners.behavior: Common once across all versions. Existing availability checks and unknown-action errors are unchanged.

member_owners.off: Use the witnessed basic compileCommandTree method and two-argument command-tree constructor. No empty history supplier is introduced.
History-on/context-off uses a four-argument typed constructor. This is an explicitly new combination, not a raw historical witness.
Remove only the three comment lines; list/help/invoke implementation remains common.

member_owners.behavior: Shared core parser/dispatch and source requirement resolution. No programmatic privilege or aggregate registry expansion.

member_owners.off: Remove palette-only imports/constants/helpers/methods while retaining basic parsing, execution and Brigadier completion.

members: typed search metadata and candidate records
member_owners.off: Use the witnessed legacy fuzzy implementation if command_palette is on; otherwise omit palette behavior entirely. No advanced candidate/frontier/search type references remain.
Remove history imports/fields/parameters/calls and ranking. Use SFMPaletteCandidate.NO_HISTORY and unmodified action scores. Constructor signatures become smaller; no empty Supplier seam is invented.

members: final suggestion filter id == null guard
member_owners.off: Restore the exact witnessed basic suggestion filter. Other nullable node handling remains outside this bounded seam.

minecraft_api_cases.proof: Seven middle-version raw variants are identical to the 26.1.2 variants after the ResourceLocation→Identifier token replacement, verified against both pairs of frozen blobs. No optional functionality is selected by Minecraft version.

new_reconstructed_combinations.description: Independent switches create useful combinations not present in frozen snapshots. In particular typed palette without history/context uses smaller constructor signatures and no historical or choice services.
new_reconstructed_combinations.history_off: No SFMCommandHistoryService, Supplier field, historical argument service, history-ranking or persisted-history calls.
new_reconstructed_combinations.context_off: No isolated choice surfaces, choice maps or choice ranking.
new_reconstructed_combinations.palette_off: No palette-only methods, fuzzy dependencies or replacement-range types.
new_reconstructed_combinations.nullable_or_diagnostics_independent: Each preserves its narrowly owned completion seam without requiring typed palette.

evidence.raw_witness_acquisition: git ls-tree and offline git cat-file --batch against 20 pinned commits; each raw blob SHA-1 object identity and SHA-256 verified before authoring
evidence.written_templates: Core UTF-8 bytes were read back after apply_patch, hashed, and matched the authoring strings exactly.

reconstruction.method: Independent JavaScript directive expander over the written template strings. This does not substitute for the production controlled renderer.

independent_combinations.method: Independent authoring directive expansion, disabled-owner reference checks, Java lexical delimiter balance and constructor-call/declaration arity matching. This is not a Java parser/type checker or real-renderer proof.
